name: Prevalence of undernourishment (PoU)
note: % population with chronic dietary energy deficit; SDG 2.1.1 anchor indicator; stability pillar of food security.

name: Number of people undernourished
note: Absolute count of undernourished persons; headline hunger metric for cross-country scale comparison.

name: Prevalence of moderate or severe food insecurity (FIES)
note: % population experiencing moderate/severe food insecurity per Food Insecurity Experience Scale; SDG 2.1.2.

name: Prevalence of severe food insecurity (FIES)
note: % population with severe food insecurity only (sub-indicator of FIES suite); access pillar proxy.

name: Average dietary energy supply adequacy (ADESA)
note: DES as % of Average Dietary Energy Requirement; availability pillar metric.

name: Average value of food production (VFP)
note: Per capita value of domestic food production in PPP; structural agricultural output proxy.

name: Share of dietary energy supply derived from cereals, roots and tubers
note: Diet dependency on starchy staples; high values signal diet vulnerability and agricultural monoculture reliance.

name: Average protein supply (g/cap/day)
note: Total protein availability per capita; utilization pillar of food security; nutrition adequacy signal.

name: Average supply of protein of animal origin (g/cap/day)
note: Animal-source protein supply; proxy for diet quality and livestock/dairy sector development.

name: Gross domestic product per capita (PPP, constant 2017 international $)
note: FAOSTAT-integrated per-capita income measure for access pillar analysis; aligns with FS access dimension.

name: Prevalence of population below minimum level of dietary energy consumption (< 1.2 x BMR)
note: Proportion below extreme caloric floor (sedentary threshold); severe deprivation measure.

name: Dietary energy supply (DES) (kcal/cap/day)
note: Average daily dietary energy available per person at national level; core availability metric.

name: Coefficient of variation of habitual caloric consumption distribution (CV)
note: Within-country inequality in food energy distribution; high CV signals food access inequality.

name: Minimum dietary energy requirement (MDER) (kcal/cap/day)
note: Population-weighted minimum caloric requirement; denominator for PoU calculation.

name: Food supply variability (kcal/cap/day, 5-year SD)
note: Standard deviation of per capita food supply over previous 5 years; stability pillar metric.

name: Access to improved water sources (% population)
note: Safe drinking water access; utilization pillar of food security; health-fragility co-factor.

name: Access to improved sanitation facilities (% population)
note: Sanitation coverage; utilization pillar; reduces nutrient absorption losses from disease.

name: Percentage of children under 5 affected by wasting (acute malnutrition)
note: Under-5 wasting prevalence; immediate food crisis signal; utilization outcome.

name: Percentage of children under 5 who are stunted (chronic malnutrition)
note: Chronic child undernutrition; long-run fragility indicator; structural food insecurity outcome.

name: Prevalence of overweight children under 5 years
note: Double burden of malnutrition signal; growing in fragile states alongside undernutrition.

name: Prevalence of obesity in the adult population (18+ years)
note: Adult obesity rate; diet quality and nutrition transition indicator.

name: Percentage of adults who are anaemic (women 15-49)
note: Anemia prevalence in women; micronutrient deprivation signal; utilization pillar outcome.

name: Prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding of infants up to 6 months
note: Infant nutrition practice; SOFI nutrition target; early childhood development proxy.

name: Percentage of low birthweight infants
note: Low birthweight rate; maternal nutrition and food security outcome.

name: Rail lines density (per 100 sq km)
note: Transport infrastructure for food access; stability/access pillar proxy for food distribution capacity.

name: Per capita food production variability (kcal/cap/day, 5-year SD)
note: Volatility of domestic food production; supply-side stability metric.

name: Per capita food supply variability (kcal/cap/day)
note: Volatility of food supply including imports; demand-side stability metric.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Cereals
note: Per capita cereal food availability from Food Balance Sheets; dietary staple dependency.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Pulses
note: Per capita pulse availability; protein diversity indicator from FBS.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Vegetables
note: Per capita vegetable supply; diet quality and agricultural diversity signal.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Fruits
note: Per capita fruit availability; micronutrient and diet quality proxy.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Meat
note: Per capita meat supply; livestock-dependence and animal protein accessibility metric.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Fish and seafood
note: Per capita fish/seafood availability; protein source diversity and coastal dependency.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Dairy and eggs
note: Per capita dairy+egg supply; animal-source food access and rural livestock system proxy.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Vegetable oils
note: Fat supply from vegetable oils; dietary energy composition signal.

name: Food supply quantity (kg/capita/year) — Sugar and sweeteners
note: Sugar supply per capita; diet composition and commodity dependence.

name: Dietary energy supply from plant-based foods (% total DES)
note: Share of calories from plant sources; diet structure and food system type signal.

name: Protein supply from animal-source foods (% total protein)
note: Animal-protein share of total protein supply; livestock system dependence and diet quality.

name: Total food supply (kcal/cap/day) — all foods aggregate
note: Aggregate dietary energy availability across all food groups; primary availability metric from FBS.

name: Food import dependency ratio (FIDR)
note: Share of domestic food supply met by imports; food sovereignty and trade vulnerability signal.

name: Domestic food production as % of total food available
note: Self-sufficiency ratio for aggregate food; strategic food security resilience indicator.

name: Cost of a healthy diet (CoHD) (PPP $/person/day)
note: Least-cost healthy diet basket cost; food access affordability metric covering 170+ countries.

name: Prevalence of population unable to afford a healthy diet (% population)
note: Share unable to afford CoHD; demand-side food access gap with income distribution component.

name: Number of people unable to afford a healthy diet
note: Absolute count unable to afford healthy diet; scale metric for intervention targeting.

name: Cost of starchy staples component of healthy diet basket (PPP $/person/day)
note: Cereal/staple sub-cost within CoHD; food price transmission and cereal market signal.

name: Cost of animal-source foods component of healthy diet basket (PPP $/person/day)
note: Protein food sub-cost; livestock and fishery price affordability signal.

name: Cost of legumes, nuts and seeds component of healthy diet basket (PPP $/person/day)
note: Plant-protein sub-cost within CoHD; affordability of protein diversity.

name: Cost of vegetables component of healthy diet basket (PPP $/person/day)
note: Vegetable sub-cost; perishable food price and supply chain efficiency indicator.

name: Cost of fruits component of healthy diet basket (PPP $/person/day)
note: Fruit sub-cost; reflects horticulture market and cold-chain development.

name: Agricultural land (1000 ha)
note: Total agricultural land area (arable + permanent crops + meadows/pastures); land resource base.

name: Agricultural land (% land area)
note: Agricultural land as share of total land; land use intensity and agricultural dependency proxy.

name: Arable land (1000 ha)
note: Land under temporary crops, temporary meadows and fallow; crop-farming resource base.

name: Arable land (ha per capita)
note: Arable land per person; population-land pressure and food production capacity signal.

name: Permanent crops (1000 ha)
note: Land under long-term crops (orchards, plantations); perennial agriculture investment.

name: Permanent meadows and pastures (1000 ha)
note: Grassland/pasture area; livestock system land base and rangeland degradation proxy.

name: Forest land (1000 ha)
note: Total forest cover; deforestation and land conversion signal; carbon sink proxy.

name: Forest land (% land area)
note: Forest share of total land; environmental fragility and deforestation monitoring metric.

name: Other land (1000 ha)
note: Non-agricultural, non-forest land (built-up, bare, etc.); land degradation and urbanization proxy.

name: Land area equipped for irrigation (1000 ha)
note: Irrigated land area; agricultural resilience to rainfall variability and water infrastructure.

name: Land area equipped for irrigation (% cultivated area)
note: Irrigation share of cultivated land; climate resilience of agriculture production system.

name: Cropland (1000 ha)
note: Arable + permanent crops combined; total actively cultivated land base.

name: Cropland (ha per capita)
note: Cultivated land per capita; land pressure and food production capacity per person.

name: Land under temporary crops (1000 ha)
note: Annual cropland extent; seasonal cultivation base for food supply.

name: Land temporarily fallow (1000 ha)
note: Fallow land area; soil restoration practice and unutilized capacity indicator.

name: Naturally regenerating forest (1000 ha)
note: Unplanted recovering forest; biodiversity and ecosystem service base.

name: Planted forest (1000 ha)
note: Commercial/plantation forest; timber production capacity and reforestation effort.

name: Agricultural land under organic agriculture (1000 ha)
note: Certified organic farmland; sustainability transition and premium-market capacity signal.

name: Area equipped for irrigation using groundwater (1000 ha)
note: Groundwater irrigation area; aquifer stress and long-run agricultural water sustainability.

name: Area actually irrigated (1000 ha)
note: Realized irrigation (vs equipped); reflects actual water availability and use efficiency.

name: Agricultural land (% land area) — share in land area
note: RL domain land use share indicator; country-level land allocation signal.

name: Agrifood systems total GHG emissions (Gt CO2eq)
note: Aggregate GHG from entire agrifood chain (farm gate + LULUCF + pre/post production); climate risk proxy.

name: Farm gate emissions (Gt CO2eq)
note: On-farm crop+livestock emissions excluding land use change; agricultural production GHG intensity.

name: AFOLU emissions (Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use) (Gt CO2eq)
note: IPCC AFOLU category aggregate; UNFCCC reporting anchor for land and agriculture sector.

name: LULUCF emissions (Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry) (Gt CO2eq)
note: Land use change and forestry net emissions; deforestation-driven climate signal.

name: Agriculture sector GHG emissions (Gt CO2eq) — IPCC Agriculture category
note: IPCC Agriculture category (enteric fermentation, manure, rice, fertilizers, crop residues).

name: Agrifood systems emissions — pre and post-production (Gt CO2eq)
note: Food supply chain non-farm emissions (food manufacturing, retail, packaging, waste).

name: Agrifood GHG emissions per capita (t CO2eq/capita)
note: Per capita agrifood emissions; intensity measure accounting for population scale.

name: Agrifood GHG emissions per unit of agricultural GDP (kg CO2eq/constant USD)
note: Emissions intensity per agricultural value; green agriculture efficiency signal.

name: Agrifood systems share of total national GHG emissions (%)
note: Agriculture+food chain share of total economy emissions; agricultural emission dominance signal.

name: Net forest emissions (CO2 removals minus emissions) (Gt CO2eq)
note: Forest carbon sink/source balance; net deforestation impact signal.

name: Enteric fermentation emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Methane from ruminant digestion; livestock herd size and type signal; largest single ag emission source.

name: Manure management emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: N2O and CH4 from manure storage/treatment; intensive livestock management proxy.

name: Manure left on pastures emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: N2O from pasture-deposited manure; extensive livestock system emission signal.

name: Manure applied to soils emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Emissions from organic fertilizer application; organic farming/soil nutrient management proxy.

name: Total livestock emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Sum of all livestock process emissions; animal production system environmental footprint.

name: Crop residue burning emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: GHG from burning of post-harvest crop residues; agronomic practice and fire risk signal.

name: Rice cultivation emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Methane from flooded rice paddies; rice-dependent food system GHG signature.

name: Synthetic fertilizers (N2O) emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: N2O from mineral/chemical fertilizer application; input-intensive agriculture signal.

name: Crop residue (soil incorporation) emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: N2O from residue left/incorporated in soil; sustainable agriculture practice proxy.

name: Total crop process emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Aggregate emissions from all crop-related processes; crop sector GHG footprint.

name: Net forest carbon stock change (CO2 removal/emission, Gg CO2)
note: Annual forest carbon flux; deforestation speed and afforestation success signal.

name: Forest land net CO2 emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Carbon stock losses from forests; land conversion and deforestation pressure.

name: Fires in humid tropical forests emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Peat/tropical forest fire GHG; land clearing for agriculture signal.

name: Fires in organic soils (peatland) emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Peatland fire emissions; extreme carbon release from agricultural land expansion.

name: Savanna fires emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Annual grassland/savanna burning; traditional land management and seasonal fire regime.

name: Drained organic soils — cropland emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: CO2/N2O from draining peatlands for crop farming; irreversible land conversion signal.

name: Drained organic soils — grassland emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Peatland drainage for pasture; long-term carbon release from pastoral expansion.

name: Energy use in agriculture — total emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: GHG from energy consumed on-farm (machinery, irrigation, heating); input modernization signal.

name: Energy use in agriculture — electricity emissions (Gg CO2eq)
note: Electricity-sourced GHG in agriculture; grid carbon intensity interacted with electrification.

name: Pre- and post-production GHG emissions — food processing (Gg CO2eq)
note: Industrial food manufacturing emissions; supply chain development and food system integration.

name: Pre- and post-production GHG emissions — food packaging (Gg CO2eq)
note: Packaging material emissions; modern food system vs traditional system signal.

name: Pre- and post-production GHG emissions — food transport (Gg CO2eq)
note: Transport and cold chain emissions; infrastructure development and food trade intensity.

name: Pre- and post-production GHG emissions — food retail (Gg CO2eq)
note: Retail stage emissions; consumer market development and food system modernization.

name: Pre- and post-production GHG emissions — food waste disposal (Gg CO2eq)
note: Landfill/disposal emissions from food waste; food loss and waste system signal.

name: Pre- and post-production GHG — household consumption (Gg CO2eq)
note: Consumer-level cooking and storage emissions; household energy poverty and food system.

name: Agriculture share of total national GHG emissions (%)
note: Agriculture+land use as % of country total emissions; agricultural emission dominance structural indicator.

name: AFOLU share of total national GHG emissions (%)
note: Land and agriculture combined share; IPCC-aligned emissions structure indicator.

name: GHG emissions intensity — per tonne of crop production (kg CO2eq/t)
note: Emission per unit crop output; production efficiency and technology adoption signal.

name: GHG emissions intensity — per tonne of livestock product (kg CO2eq/t)
note: Livestock emission per unit output; production system efficiency for animal products.

name: GHG emissions per capita — agriculture (t CO2eq/capita)
note: Per-person agricultural GHG; agriculture emission burden relative to population.

name: GHG emissions per value of agricultural production (kg CO2eq/constant 2015 USD)
note: Agricultural carbon intensity per GDP; green growth and decarbonization progress measure.

name: Nitrogen (N) fertilizer agricultural use (tonnes nutrient)
note: Total N fertilizer applied to cropland; intensification level and runoff/pollution risk.

name: Phosphorus (P2O5) fertilizer agricultural use (tonnes nutrient)
note: Phosphate fertilizer use; soil nutrient management and mining-dependent input reliance.

name: Potassium (K2O) fertilizer agricultural use (tonnes nutrient)
note: Potash fertilizer use; soil fertility management and import dependency.

name: Nitrogen fertilizer use per area of cropland (kg N/ha)
note: N application intensity per hectare; over-use/under-use signal for soil health and water quality.

name: Phosphorus fertilizer use per area of cropland (kg P2O5/ha)
note: P application intensity per hectare; soil phosphorus balance and nutrient efficiency signal.

name: Potassium fertilizer use per area of cropland (kg K2O/ha)
note: K application intensity; soil fertility sustainability and fertilizer market access.

name: Total NPK fertilizer use (tonnes nutrient)
note: Aggregate mineral fertilizer consumption; agricultural input market and food production capacity.

name: Nitrogen fertilizer production (tonnes nutrient)
note: Domestic N fertilizer output; industrial capacity and energy-intensive production vulnerability.

name: Nitrogen fertilizer import (tonnes nutrient)
note: N fertilizer import volume; supply chain vulnerability and trade dependency for food production.

name: Nitrogen fertilizer export (tonnes nutrient)
note: N fertilizer export volume; country's role in global fertilizer trade.

name: Nitrogen cropland balance (kg N/ha)
note: Net nitrogen surplus/deficit on cropland; soil health, nitrate pollution and long-run fertility.

name: Phosphorus cropland balance (kg P/ha)
note: Net P surplus/deficit; eutrophication risk and soil phosphorus depletion.

name: Potassium cropland balance (kg K/ha)
note: Net K surplus/deficit; long-term soil fertility sustainability signal.

name: Nitrogen use efficiency (NUE) — crop output per N input (%)
note: Share of applied N recovered by crops; pollution risk inverse; sustainable intensification metric.

name: Phosphorus use efficiency (PUE) (%)
note: P recovery efficiency; eutrophication and soil phosphorus accumulation management.

name: Net food production index (2014-2016=100)
note: Volume index of food produced net of feed and seed; food system output growth trajectory.

name: Net crops production index (2014-2016=100)
note: Volume index of all crops production; agricultural sector growth and yield trend.

name: Net livestock production index (2014-2016=100)
note: Volume index of livestock products; animal husbandry sector growth signal.

name: Net cereals production index (2014-2016=100)
note: Volume index of cereal production; staple food output trend; famine early-warning proxy.

name: Net food production per capita index (2014-2016=100)
note: Food output per person index; food self-sufficiency trend controlling for population growth.

name: Agricultural production gross value (constant 2014-2016 million USD)
note: Real value of all agricultural production; sector size and growth trajectory.

name: Cereal yield (hg/ha)
note: Aggregate cereal yield per unit area; agricultural technology and input adoption signal.

name: Gross value of agricultural production (current USD million)
note: Farm-gate value of total agricultural output; sector economic weight and income potential.

name: Gross value of crop production (current USD million)
note: Value of crop output; crop sector economic contribution.

name: Gross value of livestock production (current USD million)
note: Value of livestock output; animal husbandry sector economic contribution.

name: Roundwood production (m3)
note: Total wood removed from forests; logging pressure and forest resource extraction rate.

name: Wood fuel (fuelwood) production (m3)
note: Fuel wood harvest; energy poverty and forest degradation from bioenergy dependence.

name: Industrial roundwood production (m3)
note: Commercial timber production; forest industry development and export capacity.

name: Sawnwood production (m3)
note: Processed timber output; forest industry value-added and construction sector linkage.

name: Wood-based panels production (m3)
note: Composite wood product output; manufacturing diversification from forest resources.

name: Paper and paperboard production (metric tonnes)
note: Paper production from forest pulp; industrial development and forest fiber processing capacity.

name: Livestock units total (LSU)
note: Total livestock in standardized units; aggregate animal farming scale and pressure metric.

name: Livestock density (LSU per ha agricultural land)
note: Livestock per hectare; land use pressure from animal agriculture; overgrazing risk proxy.

name: Cattle share of total livestock units (%)
note: Cattle dominance in livestock mix; high-GHG ruminant reliance and red meat production structure.

name: Poultry share of total livestock units (%)
note: Poultry share in livestock system; intensification and lower-GHG protein source signal.

name: Small ruminants (sheep + goats) share of total livestock units (%)
note: Small ruminant dominance; arid/semi-arid livestock system and pastoral economy proxy.

name: Pigs share of total livestock units (%)
note: Swine share; intensive monogastric production system and feed grain demand signal.

name: Nitrogen from manure on agricultural soils (Gg N)
note: Organic N inputs from livestock manure to soils; nutrient cycling and water pollution risk.

name: Nitrogen from manure management (losses, Gg N)
note: N losses from manure storage/treatment; ammonia/nitrate pollution potential.

name: Total pesticides use on crops (kg active ingredient)
note: Aggregate pesticide consumption; chemical input intensity and environmental contamination risk.

name: Pesticide use per ha of cropland (kg a.i./ha)
note: Pesticide application rate; agro-chemical intensity and biodiversity risk signal.

name: Herbicide use on crops (kg active ingredient)
note: Herbicide consumption; weed management and land cultivation intensity.

name: Insecticide use on crops (kg active ingredient)
note: Insecticide use; pest pressure, crop protection intensity and pollinator risk.

name: Fungicide and bactericide use on crops (kg active ingredient)
note: Fungicide consumption; disease pressure and crop protection spending.

name: Mean surface temperature change on land (degrees C vs 1951-1980 baseline)
note: Country-level temperature anomaly (1961-2025); climate change exposure and agricultural risk.

name: Gross fixed capital formation in agriculture (GFCF-AFF) (constant 2015 USD)
note: Agricultural investment flows; sector modernization, productivity potential and rural development.

name: Net capital stock in agriculture (NCS-AFF) (constant 2015 USD)
note: Accumulated agricultural asset base; productive capacity and depreciation-adjusted infrastructure.

name: Agriculture orientation index for investment (AOI-INV)
note: Ag GFCF as share of GDP vs ag share of GDP; government prioritization of agricultural investment.

name: Consumption of fixed capital in agriculture (CFC-AFF) (constant 2015 USD)
note: Agricultural asset depreciation; capital maintenance burden and infrastructure aging signal.

name: Government expenditure on agriculture (USD million, constant 2015)
note: Public spending on agriculture, forestry and fishing; state investment in food system development.

name: Agriculture orientation index for government expenditure (AOI-GOV)
note: Ag spending share of total govt expenditure vs ag share of GDP; SDG 2.a.1 official indicator.

name: Credit to agriculture (USD million)
note: Bank loans to agricultural sector; financial sector support for food production and rural economy.

name: Credit to agriculture as share of total credit (%)
note: Agricultural credit share; financial inclusion and priority lending signals for rural sector.

name: Credit to agriculture as % of agricultural GDP (%)
note: Agricultural credit-to-output ratio; financial deepening relative to sector size.

name: Development flows to agriculture — total ODA commitments (USD million)
note: Official development assistance to agriculture; external dependency and food aid political economy.

name: ODA to agriculture as % of total ODA received (%)
note: Agricultural share of aid portfolio; donor priority signaling for food system fragility.

name: Total population (thousands)
note: FAOSTAT annual population series by sex/rural-urban; denominator for per capita food metrics.

name: Rural population (thousands)
note: Rural population size; agricultural labor base and food production workforce scale.

name: Rural population (% total population)
note: Rurality ratio; agricultural dependency and urbanization level proxy.

name: Employment in agriculture, forestry and fishing (thousands)
note: Agricultural sector employment; rural livelihoods dependency on food system.

name: Employment in agriculture (% total employment)
note: Agricultural employment share; agricultural dependency ratio and structural transformation.

name: Female employment in agriculture (% female employment)
note: Women's share of agricultural labor; gender dimension of food system and rural vulnerability.

name: Employment in agrifood systems (thousands)
note: Broader agrifood chain employment (farm + processing + retail); food economy labor base.

name: Agrifood systems employment (% total employment)
note: Agrifood system share of total employment; economy-wide food system integration.

name: Rural employment rate (%)
note: Employment rate in rural areas; rural livelihood security and underemployment risk.

name: Rural youth unemployment rate (%)
note: Youth joblessness in rural areas; fragility driver through idle rural youth population.

name: Rural female employment rate (%)
note: Female employment in rural areas; gender equity in rural food economy.

name: Producer price index — cereals (2014-2016=100)
note: Farm-gate cereal price trend; food inflation early signal and farmer income proxy.

name: Producer price index — oilseeds (2014-2016=100)
note: Farm-gate oilseed prices; edible oil market conditions and biofuel demand signal.

name: Producer price index — livestock products (2014-2016=100)
note: Animal product farm prices; protein affordability and pastoral income signal.

name: Producer price — wheat (USD/tonne)
note: Wheat farm gate price; global grain market signal and food import cost driver.

name: Producer price — maize/corn (USD/tonne)
note: Maize farm gate price; key staple and feed grain price signal.

name: Producer price — rice paddy (USD/tonne)
note: Rice farm gate price; Asia food security price signal and staple cost for rice-dependent countries.

name: SDG 2.1.1 Prevalence of undernourishment (%)
note: Official SDG hunger indicator from FAOSTAT SDGB domain; same as FS PoU but in SDG reporting format.

name: SDG 2.2.2 Prevalence of malnutrition — wasting in children under 5 (%)
note: Child acute malnutrition rate; SDG 2.2.2; severity signal for food crisis and healthcare system.

name: SDG 2.3.1 Volume of production per labour unit (small-scale food producers)
note: Smallholder productivity index; income and food system resilience of subsistence farmers.

name: SDG 2.3.2 Average income of small-scale food producers (PPP USD/day)
note: Smallholder income; poverty trap and rural development outcome for majority food producers.

name: SDG 2.4.1 Proportion of agricultural area under productive and sustainable agriculture (%)
note: Sustainable agriculture coverage; composite of soil health, water, biodiversity and economic viability.

name: SDG 2.5.1a Plant genetic resources secured in conservation facilities
note: Number of plant genetic resource accessions; biodiversity insurance and food system resilience.

name: SDG 2.5.2 Risk status of national livestock breeds (%)
note: Share of livestock breeds at risk of extinction; genetic diversity and food system fragility.

name: SDG 2.a.1 Agriculture orientation index for government expenditure
note: Official SDG metric for public ag spending prioritization; same as IG-002 in SDGB reporting context.

name: SDG 2.c.1 Indicator of food price anomalies (IFPA)
note: Food price volatility anomaly indicator; early warning for food price spikes and political instability.

name: SDG 5.a.1 Women with ownership or secure rights over agricultural land (%)
note: Female land rights; gender equality in food production asset access.

name: SDG 6.4.1 Water use efficiency — agricultural water productivity (USD/m3)
note: Agricultural output value per cubic meter water; water scarcity resilience and efficiency.

name: SDG 6.4.2 Level of water stress — freshwater withdrawal as % of available freshwater (%)
note: Water stress ratio; agricultural water security and conflict risk from scarcity.

name: SDG 12.3.1a Global food loss index
note: Food loss at production and supply chain stages; waste reduction target and efficiency signal.

name: SDG 15.1.1 Forest area as % of total land area
note: Forest cover share; ecosystem services, deforestation monitoring and biodiversity signal.

name: SDG 15.2.1 Progress toward sustainable forest management index
note: Composite sustainable forest management score; governance and resource management quality.

name: Wood fuel (charcoal) production (1000 metric tonnes)
note: Charcoal production; energy poverty, deforestation and biomass energy dependence indicator.

name: Bioenergy supply from agricultural residues (PJ)
note: Energy from crop residues; agri-energy nexus and renewable fuel potential.

name: Agricultural research expenditure (PPP million USD)
note: R&D spending in agriculture; innovation capacity and long-run productivity growth potential (ASTI data).

name: Agricultural research intensity (GERD-Ag as % of AgGDP)
note: R&D spending relative to agricultural output; technology investment and innovation signal.

name: Number of agricultural researchers (FTE)
note: Agricultural research human capital; science capacity for food system adaptation.

name: Artificial surfaces (% land area)
note: Built-up/urban land cover share; urbanization and land conversion from agriculture signal.

name: Cropland land cover (% land area, SEEA)
note: Cropland share from SEEA-aligned land cover accounting; agricultural land monitoring.

name: Grassland/herbaceous cover (% land area)
note: Natural grassland cover; range degradation and pastoralism capacity signal.

name: Sparse/bare/rock/ice land cover (% land area)
note: Unproductive land share; desertification and land degradation extent.

name: Tree/woody vegetation cover (% land area)
note: Woody vegetation extent including forests and agro-forestry; land carbon stock proxy.

name: GDP from agriculture, forestry and fishing (current USD billion)
note: Agricultural sector GDP; food system economic weight within FAOSTAT macro framework.

name: Agricultural GDP (% of total GDP)
note: Agriculture share of economy; structural dependency and development stage proxy.

name: Agricultural value added per agricultural worker (constant 2015 USD)
note: Labor productivity in agriculture; modernization level and rural income generation capacity.

name: FDI inflows to agriculture, forestry and fisheries (USD million)
note: Foreign direct investment into the agricultural sector; external capital for food system development.

name: FDI outflows from agriculture, forestry and fisheries (USD million)
note: Agricultural FDI outflows; reflects capital flight and foreign land acquisition activity.

name: Agricultural trade balance (exports minus imports, USD million)
note: Net agricultural trade position; food export vs import dependency signal.

name: Cereal imports (metric tonnes)
note: Volume of cereal imports; food import dependency and price shock vulnerability.

name: Cereal exports (metric tonnes)
note: Cereal export volume; agricultural export capacity and food security leverage.

name: Food exports (USD million)
note: Total food product export value; agricultural trade contribution and comparative advantage.

name: Food imports (USD million)
note: Total food import value; foreign exchange burden and supply chain vulnerability.

name: Food trade openness ratio (food trade / agricultural GDP)
note: Agriculture trade integration; global market exposure and price transmission risk.

name: Agricultural trade index — export value index (2014-2016=100)
note: Real agricultural export value trend; trade competitiveness of food sector.

name: Agricultural trade index — import value index (2014-2016=100)
note: Real agricultural import value trend; food import cost trajectory.

name: Agricultural terms of trade (export unit value / import unit value)
note: Agricultural terms of trade; whether food exporters gain or lose relative to importers.

name: Rural income per capita (PPP USD)
note: Average rural household income; poverty and food access capacity in rural areas.

name: Rural poverty headcount ratio (% rural population below poverty line)
